description: PLUSGOLF money-mode settlement (planning spec, Stroke Settings). Per hole and pair: stroke difference x per_stroke amount, doubled for the whole hole when double_down triggers (any player double-bogey or worse on a par 3, triple-bogey or worse on a par 4/5), plus a fixed winner bonus amount (birdie/eagle/albatross, winner only, not doubled). Returns per-player net money, minimal transfers, per-hole lines and a zero-sum check.

bonus_amounts.description: Fixed winner bonuses {birdie, eagle, albatross}; defaults 1/3/5 — set real amounts.

name: plusgolf__plusgolf_money_mode
